notes: Reviewed: unto before which is added — no preposition stands on the relative, the resumption is the suffix's it on לְרִשְׁתָּהּ, and בָּאִים has no bare object for rule 44 to reach (rule 17's about which). The tripartite clause leaves הִיא unrepresented with the copula on the predicate אֶרֶץ (rule 20). one end / another follow rule 15's contrastive determiners.
